- Setup/playability: Check action, fretwork (bend high up the neck), nut binding (tuning jumps), and how stable tuning is after aggressive playing.
- Sound check method: Use a clean baseline, then add a bit of drive. If possible, test through an amp similar to what you use at home.
- Practicalities: Ask about return window and a complimentary setup after it settles. Note any neck profile or pickup combo you liked so you can compare across guitars.
